sentiment: Ambition says reach further; craft says stay longer — the honest work is somehow doing both at once.

stories.title: We should be more ambitious with the software we build
stories.summary: A case that we have quietly stopped reaching for the largest things a computer could do — and that the settling happened so slowly nobody noticed it as a choice.

stories.title: The Goose Programming Language
stories.summary: Someone built a whole small language with care and put it in the open — ambition aimed not outward at scale but inward at doing one thing honestly.

stories.title: America has lost 200k of jobs in media, film and the arts. How much is AI?
stories.summary: When the reaching becomes cheap, the staying becomes the scarce thing — the part of the work that was never about speed keeps its worth.
